items.note: The lemma is stated correctly: the forward invocation adds x_S to y_S whatever the scratch values, and the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) restore every scratch wire. The plan never gives the copy, gather, scatter and side-injection gates, the neighbour rule, or why the net change (JV+RG)x is the identity (central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2 or (|S cap T|-1)/2, cancelled by the side wires), so the key step of the proof is missing.

The plan follows lines 804-825: logical input D_in^{-1}f, the invariant along edges, the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the signed route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}.

S1.3.1 states the lemma's main content: comparable nondegenerate labels, only the central edges 3->4 decrease, each by h, and the sum is Wm-2N+2L with L<N/2. It omits L=Ich and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. The method names the indicator-tensor labels and the residual table but not the bilinear form that makes neighbouring triple lines orthogonal, or the telescoping (source dimensions N, sink dimensions Wm-N) that gives the formula.

The plan states P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, the endpoint difference I_m on every route, total rank s<Wm, and that the source projections add N extra ranks (so s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b can be assembled). It does not give the argument that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the rank-one first edge 2P_{U_a}, or the computation P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m.

The derivation follows the paper: weight is additive mod 4 under orthogonality, the odd weights, the character-to-translation identity via H, the telescoping, and the 27-coordinate Z correction with C=iZC^{-1}Z. The statement gives only s<Wm, not s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c.

The plan asserts s<Wm, L<N/2, s/W<m^tau with tau<1, and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} (S7.1). It never gives the deficits eta_b and eta_c or the argument that eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 imply s/W<m^tau, and it never explicitly derives the deficit N-2L>0 from L<N/2.

Controlled shifts, cyclic row splitting into W streams and splitting on a bit are used and named in steps, but neither lemma's content (O(V) operations on a fixed number of tapes, the offset prepared in b^{O(1)} time) is stated.

The factorization, the pivot elimination, the O(V) lower-triangular transforms and the one-interchange sandwich D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j all match lines 1375-1447. The choice of a fixed odd prime q that avoids the denominators and diagonal numerators, which lets the rational identities hold mod q^b, is not mentioned. To be conservative this is marked partial.

The plan follows the paper's route: cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_M frames with the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, the three-step interchange, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule.

The plan has the paper's route: rho=O(log) high digits form a row field of range at least W^k, rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the base-m pieces cost O(V)sum a_j m^{j tau}, and binary ranges are padded to q^e. The unequal-width extension (1740-1762) is not covered.

The plan states s_c child calls on f=e/m axes giving C^{tensor e}, the row-addition count m(m-1)+3m, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. It omits the conjugation by P_M that moves the residual directions into coordinate slots (eq:phase-edge-coordinate) and the identity (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z that lets one forward call supply each inverse child.

The plan follows the paper: eight conditional additions flip the parity and restore w, packed cyclic shifts agree off a bad set of fraction at most 80(f-1)2^{-K}, and that set is repaired by extraction, destination ranks and a stable radix sort, giving O(V(L^tau+1)) under the family hypotheses. The method's wording about the guard window is slightly off (see errors).

The node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the row split giving V/W children, and the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) are stated. The leaf cutoff e<d^beta with F=O(e), the bound K<=e^{c/beta}, the base-m pieces and the condition max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda' are missing, and the reason given ('because s/W<m strictly') is loose.

The statement matches: an H_0 layer on D<=d K-bit chunks of polynomial records in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with one final truncation and error below sqrt2 2^{-p}. The guard-width argument is reduced to 'a fixed power of d, o(p)'. The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) with epsilon C_1<1 are not shown.

Character cancellation, decimation in frequency with twiddle omega_t^{-k}, the stored bit-reversed order B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the grouping into H then J_E, the layout L, the per-round truncation commuting with J_E, and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]) all match the paper.
The plan follows the paper: B_0=2^{4p}, four products, centred residues with |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, the streams ac-be and ae+bc, the negacyclic reduction, and the shift by p+l.
The plan has the retained LB order, the normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) with F^+F^-=I/M, the cancellation of LB, the error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} by bilinear contraction, and the stated cost.

The maps S, T, C and D, the bound ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta} with a Neumann series, A=S' and B_0=D'J'C giving P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, the linewise padded-box implementation, and axis exposure in O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) all match the paper.
The chirp period and coefficient check, the dilation identity F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+ giving RF_s^+R=F_s^+, and the normalized convolution rule giving (u*v)/S^2 all follow the paper.

tau, sigma, epsilon, kappa, b, p, d, K, T and r are given, along with the prime interval and the bounds T/2<S<T and degree<S. lambda, c, lambda', delta and beta are not given numerically, and neither are eta=1/(4d) or alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}), which are needed for alpha^4 theta_i>p and gamma=o(b).

The plan follows the paper: Phi respects x^S=1 and its image has order S, the triangular digit formula, the reordered axes updated i=d..1 from the original digits, padding preserved, and the cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)).
The plan matches lines 4303-4342: (zeta y)^r=1, the map is diagonal and isometric, the wrap factor is zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T.

The plan has the chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, the algorithm steps (Phi, two transforms, truncated product, opposite transform scaled by S, then 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries), and the meaning of the two occurrences of S.

The plan follows the paper's chain: E_ring<5TL, chirp<8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL with norm<.501, (3E_s+2), final error 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, and the carry invariant. E_w<28*2^gamma T^2L is implicit in S7.8.4.

The plan states V=Tp, the minimum margin 2^{-181}=2kappa, setup and exceptional repairs o(V), log powers at most p^kappa, and O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). S8 does not list the seven normalized costs or the margins g_1..g_7, and it does not identify g_2=epsilon c(1-tau) as the minimum. The individual cost terms appear only in S4 and S5.
S0 says the bound refutes the n log n conjecture in this model, but it does not say what an eventual lower bound would require or give the liminf argument.

errors.says: The packed shifts agree with the intended XORs except at addresses whose guard values lie within 20 of the segment boundary.
errors.paper: The bad set B consists of addresses where a guard value g fails 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11. Each guard has twenty excluded values, ten at each end of its range. Equivalently, the K-bit segment value starts outside [20,2^K-21]. The plan conflates guard values with segment values.

errors.says: The recurrence unrolls to O(d^{lambda'}) because s/W<m strictly.
errors.paper: The unrolling also needs s/W<=m^sigma with sigma<1, the leaf cutoff e<d^beta where F(e)=O(e), the bound K<=e^{c/beta} so that the overhead is O(e^lambda), and lambda'>max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}. s/W<m alone is the strict saving, not a sufficient reason.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. The scalar exchange network and frames lead to subspace labels and the two interfaces (s<Wm). These give the interchange recurrence and arbitrary-width swaps, the phase-frame layer recurrence, and synthetic transforms and convolution, then resampling, chirp, the CRT and twist, the algorithm, exact recovery and the time table. The tree is thinnest at the central saving: it asserts L<N/2 and s<Wm without the loss ratios, the deficits eta or the derivation of tau=1-2^{-50}. It also omits the network's cancellation mechanism, the P_M conjugation in the layer recursion, the leaf and K conditions in unrolling the layer recurrence, and the explicit margins in the final tally.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire is reconstructed. The defining data (h=100, banks indexed by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) never appears, and the triples are only alluded to in S1.3.
S1.2 states the common frame per gate commuting with a pointwise gate, the implemented D_out S D_in^{-1}, and that only the edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} cost anything.

S1.3 gives nested nondegenerate labels built from tensor products of triple indicator lines. S1.3.1 gives comparable labels on every edge, with the only decreases on central edges 3->4, each losing h. The ambient space F^{tensor 3} of dimension m is implicit rather than named.

The plan says each frame change costs the dimension of its orthogonal residual (projection matrices P_U) and that the source projections add N extra ranks. The identity rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U is used but not proved, and the rank-one source edge is described only as 'N extra ranks'.
The plan states sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L plus N extra source ranks, which gives s=Wm-N+2L. L=Ich is not stated, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b is left implicit.
L<N/2 and s<Wm are asserted, but the ratios 100/539 and 101/539 never appear and the plan does not show the deficit N-2L>0 that makes the saving strict. To be conservative this is marked mentioned.
S1.3.2 gives the negated source projection and the endpoint difference I_m on every route. S2.2.2 turns this into H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
S2.1 has the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and S2.2.4 has exactly s recursive calls per node.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and F_k=O(e^tau) for s/W<m^tau are all present, and tau=1-2^{-50} appears in S7.1. The justification of the exponent (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20) is missing.

central.summary: Seven of the nine central steps are reconstructed. The plan carries the mechanism from frames through labels, rank as dimension change, the endpoint identity, and one recursive call per unit of rank, to the recurrence. Its weak points are the numerical core: the fixed network's parameters (h=100, triples, N, m) and the loss ratios L/N=100/539 and 101/539 that make s<Wm strict are missing, and the exponent tau is stated without the eta-based justification.
